bias.zh: 反弹 · 守住 100 和 200 日均线，仍低于 $648

read.en: Meta was flat on Nov 10 at $641.39, trading $635.50–647.28 on light volume (0.52x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($625.6), 10-day ($620.8), 100-day ($634.8) and 200-day ($631.7) and below the 30-day ($678.6); only the 5 and 100-day are rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($585.07), and RSI is 46.
read.zh: Meta 11月10日持平，收于 $641.39，盘中区间 $635.50–647.28，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.52 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$625.6）、10 日（$620.8）、100 日（$634.8）和 200 日（$631.7）均线上方，30 日（$678.6）均线下方；仅 5、100 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$585.07），RSI 为 46。

read.en: No level changed: the $647.28 high again stopped in the $643.1–648 band, and the $635.50 low held above the 100 and 200-day ($631.7–634.8). Resistance is $643.1–648 (Nov 4, 9 and 10 highs, Oct 23 high), then $678.6–681.1 (30-day, Oct 22 high). Support is $630–635.5, then $620.8–625.6 (10 and 5-day) and $606.4–610.1. A close above $648 would target $679–681; below $630, $621–626.

s.en: 100 and 200-day averages ($631.7–634.8); Nov 9 low $630; Nov 10 low $635.50
Nov 2 low $606.4; Nov 6 low $606.66; Oct 30 and Nov 3 lows $610.1
